items.text: Astro + visual page builder + 20+ block types.

items.content: Each page is a JSON file under `content/pages/`. The admin tool gives you a visual block editor.
The blog and project collections are MDX. Pages use blocks, but most text fields support `inline` markdown (**bold**, *italic*, [links](#)).
Tailwind utilities + CSS variables. Switch the accent palette from the header.

items.label: Install
items.content: Run `npm install` then `npm run dev` to spin up the dev server.

items.label: Build
items.content: `npm run build` outputs static HTML to `dist/`.

items.label: Admin
items.content: `npm run admin` opens the visual content editor on http://localhost:4322.
